scope: production mode inventory and Stage-4 axis plan only; no FE mesh, Basix space, operator action, factor, or PDE solve

timing.note: The first live inventory command did not record UTC or monotonic timestamps. 11.9 s is the command tool's observed wall duration and is retained as preparation cost; no B0 execution window was frozen.

mode_manifest.note: The production builder returned the canonical digest and byte length, but the first command printed only the summary and discarded the manifest bytes. The modes will not be regenerated for this capture.

capture_integrity.full_per_q_and_per_sector_vectors: The production mapper printed the complete vectors in the original command output; this compact capture retains their exact totals, empty-q range, and extrema only.

source.source_digest_note: The selected source files were unchanged after mode generation; the bundle digest was computed retrospectively from those exact file contents. It is not a commit SHA.

environment.environment_scope: qualified C1 Linux ABI used for lightweight configuration and inventory only

mesh_axis_plan.material_plane_alignment: PASS: x=16.5/33.5 nm, y=15/35 nm, z=0/120 nm all aligned

mode_inventory.scope_limit: This is the full auto_propagating port list, not an infinite or evanescent DtN truncation qualification.

q_sector_inventory.q_pair_rule: sector t uses q=t and q=t+100 for t=0..99

whole_object_resource_ledger.local_component_measurement: May proceed after main freezes the source and a single-case contract/window; do not wait for all-q factor totals before safe local measurement.

derived_p6_row_ledger.basis: G13 p6 expected profile scaled only by Ny ratio 200/10; this is not a Basix or DOLFINx readback
derived_p6_row_ledger.global_storage_rows_candidate_basis: derived p6 hexahedral topology: 6*edges + 60*faces + 450*cells for Nx=10, Ny=200, Nz=14; boundary edges/faces are counted directly rather than scaling the G13 total linearly
derived_p6_row_ledger.global_storage_rows_correction_note: The earlier capture scaled the G13 storage total by Ny=200/10 and obtained 18,695,280. Direct topology counting gives 18,501,024; retain the prior value for audit, but use the direct-count value as the current derived candidate. Neither value is a Basix/DOLFINx readback.

unknown_objects: Basix/DOLFINx dofmap, owned/ghost rows, and actual FE system sizes
